scope: Evidence draft for the current device; supplied diagnostic and parent-reported System Settings observations only; no new UI inspection or repository modification by this agent.

physicalPanelPixels.kind: parent-supplied native panel dimensions, distinct from App diagnostic estimated_pixels

estimatedBackingPixels.source: App diagnostic estimated_pixels; logical frame multiplied by backing scale

original.meaning: Auto-hide applies in full-screen context; ordinary-desktop visibility must be separately observed.

nextNonDefaultScenario.status: planned; execution and observations are not established by the supplied diagnostic

restoreTarget.status: restore target; completion requires later evidence

menuBarSettingsSequence.menuBarAutoHideModeAtDiagnosticTimestamp: not reported by the App diagnostic; do not infer from top_reserved_height or safe area

derivedConsistencyChecks.defaultScalingConclusionSource: System Settings default marker; not backingScaleFactor == 2

boundaries: Default scaling is visually confirmed for the supplied current Settings observation; scale factor 2 alone does not identify the default scaled resolution.
AppKit point geometry, estimated backing pixels (2940x1912), and native panel pixels (2560x1664) are separate quantities.
The menuBarModes visible entry in DI-B01 does not itself prescribe changing the global setting to Never; preserve the actual raw option and observed desktop context.
Menu-bar automatic hiding and a physical notch safe area are separate; neither top_reserved_height nor safe_area alone proves the selected global menu-bar mode.
The supplied diagnostic does not establish completion of the later 1280x832 / always-auto-hide scenario or restoration of original Settings.
Current geometry, default selection and menu-bar observations do not complete DI-B01, DI-B02, the other hardware scenarios, clean-Mac installation, T39, or future U02 implementation.
A compact presentation state and App-window capture do not establish complete unobstructed rendering around the physical notch.
